description:
The Modern Metal Masterpiece for Racing

The Titanio is the pinnacle of Masi’s craftsmanship — a tribute to the enduring beauty and strength of metal. Handcrafted from premium titanium in a world-class facility, this bike represents the highest level of material engineering. Known for its lightweight resilience, corrosion resistance, and unmatched durability, titanium offers a ride that is both agile and comfortable, with a touch of luxury.

Designed with racing performance in mind, the Titanio is built for riders who crave the rush of speed and the exhilaration of competition. Its precise geometry ensures responsive handling and maximum power transfer, making it the perfect choice for race day dominance. Whether it's a fast-paced road race, a challenging criterium, or an all-day endurance event, the Titanio thrives under pressure.

A material once reserved for aerospace and the world’s most exclusive cycling frames, titanium is now the heart of the Titanio. Masi’s dedication to meticulous craftsmanship ensures every weld and finish exemplifies perfection. The bike’s sleek lines and polished aesthetic echo the brand’s legacy, while the modern design delivers the speed and performance expected from a high-end race machine.

The Titanio is not only about raw power but also about comfort over long distances. Its titanium frame absorbs road vibrations, allowing racers to stay fresh and focused through every mile. For those who push their limits and race to win, the Titanio provides the ultimate edge.

Designed for racers who demand nothing less than the best, the Titanio is both an engineering achievement and a statement of elegance. It honors the era when Masi built frames for cycling legends while embracing the future with cutting-edge performance. From epic gran fondos to intense sprint finishes, the Titanio moves with effortless grace.
